observations: Three photos show a pair of car headlights.

Photo 0: Close-up of one headlight held in hand, showing the back with mounting points and a label. The lens is clear with visible internal structure and an amber turn signal section. The housing is black plastic with some wear and dirt.
Photo 1: Both headlights lying on a concrete floor, angled to show front and side. The design includes a chrome trim around the lens and a distinct angular shape with vertical ridges on the side.
Photo 2: Same as photo 1, slightly different angle, showing the front and side of both headlights. The right headlight (viewer's left) has a visible label on the back, partially obscured.
The headlights appear to be from a modern sedan, likely a Mercedes-Benz based on the seller's claim and the watermark 'A1 MERCEDES GLOBAL'.
No visible damage to the lenses, but the housing shows signs of use and minor scuffs.
No visible brand or model markings on the front or side of the headlights. The label on the back in photo 0 is small and not legible.

claims.evidence: The seller's claim is not supported by visible text in the photos. The watermark 'A1 MERCEDES GLOBAL' suggests Mercedes-Benz, but no model or year is readable on the headlights themselves. The design is consistent with W205 C-Class headlights, but this cannot be confirmed from the photos alone.
